original_title: CDMO folks handling OEB 3–5 compounds from gram to kg scale — what PPE/gowning are you actually using?
title: CDMO folks handling OEB 3–5 compounds from gram to kg scale — what PPE/gowning are you actually using?
blurb: For those working in CDMOs making potent compounds—roughly OEB 3–5, depending on your site’s banding scheme—at gram through kg scale, what gowning/PPE are you using in practice? I’m especially curious about how much it changes with: •Band: OEB 3 vs 4 vs 5, or however your site defines them •Scale: bench/gram-scale, pilot, and kg-scale manufacturing •Operation: open dispensing/weighing, charging solids, filtration/drying, milling, packaging, cleaning, etc. •Containment: open hood, downflow booth, isolator/glovebox, closed transfers/SBVs, RABS, etc.

original_title: Safety concerns when synthesizing Ti₃C₂Tₓ MXene using concentrated HF
title: Safety concerns when synthesizing Ti₃C₂Tₓ MXene using concentrated HF
blurb: Hi everyone, I recently started my PhD, and my project involves synthesizing MXenes from the Ti₃AlC₂ MAX phase. The protocol I have been looking at uses an etching mixture of 2 mL of 50 wt% HF, 12 mL of HCl, and 6 mL of deionized water in an HDPE bottle. 1 g of Ti₃AlC₂ MAX phase is then slowly added and stirred for 24 hours at 350 rpm and 35 °C. The reaction also involves hydrogen evolution, which raises concerns regarding gas management and pressure buildup. Unfortunately, our dedicated HF-compatible fume hood was destroyed in an accident, and the only available option is a conventional fume

original_title: Facile Gram-Scale Solution Phase Synthesis of a Universal Cathepsin B-Cleavable Antibody-Drug Conjugate Linker.
title: A cathepsin B linker you can actually make by the gram
blurb: Solution-phase synthesis instead of the usual solid-phase slog, scaled to grams rather than milligrams, for a cathepsin-B-cleavable ADC linker they're billing as universal. Whether "universal" survives contact with someone else's antibody is the part worth watching.

original_title: Digestion and Orthogonal Click Conjugation Enables Nanopore Reading of Proteins
title: Turning proteins into DNA sandwiches so nanopores can read them
blurb: Chymotrypsin chops a protein into fragments ending in tyrosine, which sets up oxidation-triggered click chemistry to bolt DNA onto both ends, off reagents you could just buy. The resulting DNA-peptide-DNA conjugates are something a nanopore can read, single molecule at a time, though you're still reading fragments rather than the intact chain.

original_title: Gallium-68 and zirconium-89 complexes of DFO-analogs for molecular imaging applications using PET/CT
title: A new DFO cousin for 68Ga and 89Zr, built the solid-phase way
blurb: Another oligohydroxamate chelator in the desferrioxamine family, DFO*sp3, made by solid-phase synthesis and stacked up against plain DFO for complexing the two workhorse PET radiometals. Worth it only if it beats DFO on stability, since plain DFO is known to slowly let go of zirconium.

original_title: The Second Nitrogen Fits: Development of Diazine-Based Macrocyclic Chelators to Stably Bind Radionuclides Used in Targeted Alpha Therapy.
title: A second nitrogen in the macrocycle, meant to hold onto alpha emitters
blurb: Diazine-based macrocyclic chelators built to bind targeted-alpha-therapy radionuclides more stably by working a second nitrogen into the ring. Stability is the whole game here, since a chelator that lets go near healthy tissue is how an alpha emitter stops being targeted.

original_title: "Imaging Triplets on Two Wheels": 61Cu-, 64Cu-, and 68Ga-labeled Bicyclic Peptides Targeting Nectin-4 Enable High-Contrast PET Imaging of Urothelial Carcinoma and Triple-Negative Breast Cancer.
title: Same bicyclic peptide, three different isotopes, one Nectin-4 target
blurb: A Nectin-4-targeting bicyclic peptide labeled three ways, with 61Cu, 64Cu, and 68Ga, all giving high-contrast PET in both urothelial carcinoma and triple-negative breast cancer models. Really a bet that one scaffold can take whichever isotope is on hand, with a matched copper therapeutic the obvious next move.

original_title: Adaptive Dosing of Actinium-225 Alpitatug Satetraxetan, a KLK2-Targeted Radioligand Therapy, in mCRPC - Pedro Barata - UroToday
title: Dosing actinium-225 by the numbers instead of one dose fits all
blurb: A conference look at adaptive dosing for Ac-225 alpitatug satetraxetan, the KLK2-targeted radioligand, in metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer. Talk, not trial data, but adaptive dosing is exactly the right question when the therapeutic window on an alpha emitter is already thin.

original_title: Aziridination-Based Crosslinking Enables Site-Resolved Elucidation of Lipid Binding and Protein Conformational Changes.
title: Aziridine crosslinks pin down where lipids actually grab a protein
blurb: An aziridination-based crosslinking method that maps lipid-binding sites and the conformational shifts that go with them at site-level resolution, instead of just confirming a protein binds lipid somewhere. A chemistry-tool paper, useful if it generalizes past whatever protein got picked to show it off.

original_title: Phase 2 Clinical Trial of 225Ac-LNC1011 in the Treatment of Metastatic Castration-Resistant Prostate Cancer
title: Another Ac-225 PSMA-adjacent trial, this one out of Fujian
blurb: Phase 2 trial of 225Ac-LNC1011 in metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer, paired with 68Ga-PSMA-11 for imaging, run through Fujian Medical University's affiliated hospital. Already active and not recruiting, so this is a status marker, not a launch.

original_title: Preclinical PET Imaging of Trastuzumab Deruxtecan in Tumors with Heterogeneous HER2 Expression.
title: Imaging where Enhertu actually goes when HER2 is patchy
blurb: Preclinical PET imaging tracks trastuzumab deruxtecan's distribution in tumors where HER2 expression is heterogeneous rather than uniform. That's the case that matters clinically, since patchy HER2 is exactly where the ADC's bystander killing either saves the day or doesn't.

original_title: Modulating Hydrogel Architecture via Cross-Linker Length for High-Resolution Tissue Imaging and Photochemical Sectioning.
title: Tuning hydrogel mesh size for cleaner tissue sectioning
blurb: Cross-linker length sets the hydrogel's architecture, which in turn sets how well it performs for high-resolution tissue imaging and photochemical sectioning. Incremental materials tuning, but the kind of knob you want dialed in before committing to one hydrogel recipe.

original_title: Engineering Poly(ε-caprolactone)-Based Maleimide-Enediyne Micelles for Next-Generation Anticancer Therapies.
title: Packaging a DNA-shredding warhead into a polymer micelle
blurb: Enediynes cleave DNA outright but are too hot to dose on their own, so this hangs one off a maleimide handle inside a poly(caprolactone) micelle as a delivery vehicle for anticancer use. Thin on the details, but the logic of the design is the whole story here.

original_title: TheraPb Phase 1b: First-in-Human Dose-Escalation and Optimization Study of (212)Pb-ADVC001 in PSMA-Positive Metastatic Androgen Pathway Modulation-Resistant Prostate Cancer.
title: Lead-212 goes after PSMA in prostate cancer that's stopped responding to hormone therapy
blurb: First-in-human Phase 1b dose-escalation of 212Pb-ADVC001, an alpha-emitting radioligand, in PSMA-positive prostate cancer that's already resistant to androgen-pathway drugs. This is literally the first time it's gone into a person, so it's about finding a tolerable dose, not efficacy yet.

original_title: A Biocompatible Cu(I)-Catalyzed Click Chemistry Framework for Long-Term Cell Tracking.
title: Getting Cu(I) click chemistry safe enough for long-term cell tracking
blurb: A copper-catalyzed azide-alkyne click framework built to be biocompatible enough to label cells and track them over the long haul, which matters because copper toxicity is usually the reason this chemistry doesn't get used that way.

original_title: Maleimide-Thiol Conjugation Enables the Optimization of 68Ga-Labeled CAIX Targeting PET Probes.
title: Dialing in a 68Ga PET tracer for hypoxic tumors via maleimide-thiol chemistry
blurb: Swapping in maleimide-thiol conjugation to optimize 68Ga-labeled probes targeting CAIX, the marker tumors switch on under hypoxia. A conjugation-chemistry tweak aimed at squeezing better tracer performance out of an existing target.

original_title: XL-MS and De Novo Protein Design Identified a Common Motif for TREM2 Binding.
title: Crosslinking mass spec and de novo protein design land on the same TREM2 motif
blurb: XL-MS and de novo protein design, two unrelated methods, converge on a common binding motif for TREM2, the microglial receptor everyone's chasing for Alzheimer's immunotherapy. Two orthogonal approaches agreeing is the actual reason this is worth noting.

original_title: Spirocyclic Reconfiguration of the Piperazine Linker Improves Quinoline-Based FAPI PET Tracer Performance.
title: A spirocycle swap in the linker gives a FAPI PET tracer a lift
blurb: Reconfiguring the piperazine linker into a spirocycle on a quinoline-based FAPI tracer, used to image cancer-associated fibroblasts, improves its performance. Incremental linker chemistry, but that's how these tracers actually get better.

original_title: Bridging the Gap between Discovery and Clinical Reality in Radiopharmaceuticals: A Translational Science Perspective on Safety, Efficacy, and Manufacturability.
title: A reality check on turning radiopharmaceutical hits into actual drugs
blurb: A translational-science perspective on what actually trips up radiopharmaceuticals on the way from discovery to clinic: safety, efficacy, and manufacturability, with manufacturability usually being the one nobody budgeted for.

original_title: Bridging Research and Industry to Advance Actinium-225 Cancer Therapies - International Atomic Energy Agency
title: IAEA tries to get actinium-225 research and industry talking to each other
blurb: A report on bridging research and industry to scale up actinium-225 production for cancer therapy, the supply bottleneck that shows up every time someone designs an alpha-therapy trial around it.

original_title: A Latent DNA-Protein Cross-Link Agent as a Chemical Adjuvant for Photodynamic Therapy.
title: A hidden DNA-protein crosslinker doubles as a photodynamic therapy booster
blurb: A latent cross-linking agent that stays quiet until triggered, then acts as a chemical adjuvant to boost photodynamic therapy. The staying-quiet part is the design feature, not an afterthought.

original_title: Spontaneous nickel-catalyzed dityrosine crosslinking to form highly tunable elastin-like polypeptide hydrogels.
title: Nickel catalysis stitches tyrosines into tunable ELP hydrogels
blurb: Nickel-catalyzed dityrosine crosslinking, described as spontaneous, links up elastin-like polypeptides into hydrogels with tunable properties. Convenient if it really needs no babysitting, though a metal catalyst sitting right there makes 'spontaneous' do some work.

original_title: Preclinical Evaluation of [225Ac]Ac-NM600 Therapeutic Potential for Localized and Metastatic Triple-Negative Breast Cancer.
title: An alpha emitter that skips the receptor hunt
blurb: Ac-225 hung on NM600, a tumor-selective lipid rather than a receptor ligand, tested in mice with both localized and metastatic triple-negative breast cancer. TNBC has no good targeted option right now, so a construct that doesn't need a specific receptor is worth watching. Preclinical only.

original_title: Photoactivated Cross-Linking Mass Spectrometry for Probing Multidomain Protein Dynamics in Inducible Nitric Oxide Synthase.
title: Catching iNOS's domains mid-shuffle
blurb: Photoactivated cross-linking mass spec used to track how the multiple domains of inducible nitric oxide synthase move relative to each other. A structural methods paper more than a result.

original_title: Discovery of an Ultrasound-Responsive Arylurea-Dihydrotetrazine Architecture for Ultrasound-Programmed Bioorthogonal Chemistry.
title: Tetrazine click chemistry with an ultrasound on-switch
blurb: A dihydrotetrazine-arylurea that sits inert until ultrasound flips it into the reactive tetrazine, letting a bioorthogonal click reaction be triggered on demand. The appeal over light-triggered versions is obvious: ultrasound actually gets through tissue.

original_title: Video from EANM: Wadsak discusses new radiopharmaceutical targets and supply challenges - AuntMinnieEurope
title: Wadsak on where radiopharma targets go next, and why the isotopes keep running short
blurb: A conference interview from EANM covering new radiopharmaceutical target ideas and the ongoing supply headaches that keep tripping up the field.

original_title: Preclinical Evaluation and Preliminary Clinical Study of Al18F-NOTA for PET/CT Imaging of Renal Function.
title: A simpler 18F tag, aimed at the kidneys
blurb: Al18F-NOTA sidesteps the usual fiddly fluorine-18 chemistry, and this one's been run through preclinical testing plus a preliminary clinical look for PET/CT imaging of renal function. Early days but there's already human data, not just mice.

original_title: High-Affinity Y1 Receptor Theranostics: First-in-Class Stabilized Nonapeptides for Breast Cancer Imaging and Therapy.
title: A stabilized nonapeptide going after breast cancer's Y1 receptor
blurb: First-in-class high-affinity Y1 receptor nonapeptides, engineered for stability, built as a theranostic pair for imaging and treating breast cancer. Peptides this short usually fall apart fast in vivo, so the stabilization is the point.

original_title: TheraPb Phase 1b: First-in-Human Dose-Escalation and Optimization Study of 212 Pb-ADVC001 in PSMA-Positive Metastatic Androgen Pathway Modulation–Resistant Prostate Cancer
title: Lead-212 goes first-in-human in PSMA-positive prostate cancer that's already stopped responding to hormone drugs
blurb: TheraPb's phase 1b is a dose-escalation and optimization study of 212Pb-ADVC001, an alpha emitter targeting PSMA, in metastatic prostate cancer resistant to androgen pathway modulation. This stage is about finding a safe dose, not proving it works.

original_title: Evaluation of 68Ga Labeling Strategies and Thermostability of HER2-Targeted Nanobody NB46.
title: Getting Ga-68 onto a HER2 nanobody without wrecking it
blurb: A comparison of 68Ga labeling strategies for the HER2-targeted nanobody NB46, paired with a look at how well it holds up thermally. The kind of unglamorous optimization that decides whether a nanobody tracer actually survives to the clinic.

original_title: Selective and Efficient Functionalization of P22 Virus-Like Particles Using an Asparaginyl Ligase.
title: Tagging a virus shell with an enzyme instead of a chemist's toolkit
blurb: An asparaginyl ligase used to selectively and efficiently attach cargo to P22 virus-like particles. Enzymatic site-specificity over the usual conjugation chemistry grab bag.

original_title: Radiobiological dosimetry using hybrid imaging-derived spatiotemporal dose distributions for(131)I therapy of metastatic thyroid cancer.
title: Tracking where the I-131 dose actually ends up, not just where it started
blurb: Dosimetry built from hybrid imaging that captures how the radiation dose distribution shifts in space and time during I-131 therapy for metastatic thyroid cancer, rather than a single static dose map.

original_title: In Vivo Chemical Cross-Linking Coupled with Reversed-Phase Co-Fractionation Mass Spectrometry Enables Protein Complex Analysis.
title: Mapping protein complexes without pulling them out of the cell
blurb: Crosslinks proteins in vivo first, then separates the mix by reversed-phase co-fractionation before the mass spec run, so complexes get read out closer to their native state instead of after a pulldown. A methods paper, but a useful one if the fractionation step actually resolves distinct complexes instead of smearing them together.

original_title: Radiopharmaceutical growth is outpacing manufacturing infrastructure - The Pharma Letter
title: Radiopharma demand is growing faster than anyone can make the stuff
blurb: Trade-press framing rather than new data: manufacturing capacity for radiopharmaceuticals isn't keeping pace with how many of these drugs are getting approved. Tracks with how often supply, not chemistry, ends up the limiting factor for isotopes like Ac-225.

original_title: Preclinical Evaluation of 89Zr-Labeled Anti-Nectin-4 Antibody for Enhanced PET Imaging in Bladder Urothelial Carcinoma.
title: A Zr-89 tracer for nectin-4, the same target enfortumab vedotin hits
blurb: Preclinical PET imaging data on an 89Zr-labeled anti-nectin-4 antibody in bladder urothelial carcinoma. Nectin-4 is already the hot ADC target, so a companion imaging agent tracks, but this is still animal data before anyone scans a patient with it.

original_title: Albumin-Binding Modification Improves Tumor Retention of Hydrophilic αvβ6-Targeting Radiotheranostic Tracers.
title: Bolting an albumin binder onto an alphavbeta6 tracer so it sticks around longer
blurb: An albumin-binding modification improves tumor retention of a hydrophilic alphavbeta6-targeting radiotheranostic tracer. Standard half-life extension trick lifted from the peptide-drug playbook, now applied to radiotheranostics.

original_title: Thianthrenium ylides for safe carbene transfer
title: A carbene source that doesn't want to blow up on you
blurb: Thianthrenium ylides pitched as a safer carbene transfer reagent than the diazo compounds everyone handles nervously. If it transfers carbenes as cleanly as diazo chemistry without the explosion risk, that's a real bench upgrade and not just a safety footnote.

original_title: Slide-Ring Hydrogel Networks Cross-Linked by Movable Cucurbit[8]uril/Macromer Host-Guest Complexes.
title: A hydrogel where the crosslinks can slide instead of lock in place
blurb: Cucurbit[8]uril host-guest complexes act as movable crosslinks here rather than fixed covalent junctions, the slide-ring trick for spreading stress across the network instead of concentrating it at rigid points. Should mean tougher, more stretchable gels, assuming the host-guest binding holds under real strain.

original_title: Production of (135)La via the (136)Ba(p,2n)(135)La reaction and its DNA-damaging properties as a low-energy Auger electron emitter.
title: La-135 as a new Auger emitter, made by firing protons at barium
blurb: Makes La-135 via the (136)Ba(p,2n) reaction and checks whether its low-energy Auger electrons actually damage DNA, the property that would make it useful for targeted radiotherapy. Both the production route and the damage data are first-look results, not a finished case for the isotope.

original_title: Site-Selective Tyrosine Modification and Cross-Linking of the Grass Pollen Allergen Phl p 5a by Peroxynitrite.
title: Peroxynitrite leaves specific tyrosine fingerprints on a grass pollen allergen
blurb: Peroxynitrite modifies and crosslinks the allergen Phl p 5a at particular tyrosine residues rather than randomly. The site-selectivity is the finding, which matters given the theory that air-pollution nitrative stress makes allergens worse.

original_title: Peptide Sequence and Backbone Conjugation Chemistry Direct Alginate Hydrogel Bioactivity for Human Mesenchymal Stem Cell Expansion.
title: Which peptide you graft onto alginate, and how, decides if stem cells actually expand
blurb: Both the peptide sequence and the chemistry used to attach it to the alginate backbone change how well the resulting hydrogel supports human mesenchymal stem cell expansion. The conjugation chemistry isn't just a formality here, it's doing real biological work alongside the peptide choice.

original_title: BMS Antibody-Drug Conjugate Iza-Bren Bests Chemotherapy in HR-Positive Breast Cancer - GenomeWeb
title: BMS's ADC beats chemo head-to-head in HR-positive breast cancer
blurb: Iza-bren outperformed chemotherapy in HR-positive breast cancer, per BMS. Headline comparison only, so worth waiting on the actual trial numbers before calling it a new standard of care.

original_title: A self-assembled and covalently stabilized FcRn-binding albumin fragment-payload assembly.
title: Self-assembling albumin carrier that welds itself shut
blurb: An FcRn-binding albumin fragment carrying a payload that first self-assembles, then gets covalently locked in place, presumably because the noncovalent version wasn't stable enough to trust in circulation. Half-life extension via FcRn recycling, with the covalent lock as the actual new bit.

original_title: Longitudinal PET Imaging Reveals the Biological Fate, Pharmacokinetics, and Clearance of Zirconium-89-Labeled MXene Nanosheets In Vivo.
title: Watching MXene nanosheets clear out of the body, PET-style
blurb: Zirconium-89 labeled MXene nanosheets tracked by longitudinal PET to map where they go and how they clear in vivo. Useful groundwork if MXenes are going to be more than a materials-science curiosity in therapeutics, but it's biodistribution data, not a therapy.

original_title: Development of Novel 211At-Labeled Agent for Neurotensin Receptor 1-Targeted α-Particle Therapy.
title: A new astatine-211 warhead aimed at neurotensin receptor 1
blurb: A novel At-211 labeled agent built to hit neurotensin receptor 1 for alpha-particle therapy, the short-range high-LET approach everyone's chasing for solid tumors. Early med-chem development, so a new ligand rather than any trial data.

original_title: C–C Bond Formation via the Addition or Redistribution of Hydrogen: Chemical Synthesis Beyond Premetalated Reagents or Metallic Reductants
title: Making carbanions without the carbanions
blurb: Transient C-nucleophiles generated catalytically via hydrogen transfer from H2, isopropanol, or formic acid, standing in for the usual stoichiometric organometallics or zerovalent metal reductants that are hazardous and a pain to prep. A safer route to C-C bond formation if it generalizes beyond the cases shown.
venue: Journal of the American Chemical Society

original_title: Enantioselective and Diastereoselective Synthesis of Multisubstituted Spirocyclopentane Oxindoles through NHC Catalysis
title: Spiro oxindoles built with an NHC catalyst doing double duty on selectivity
blurb: NHC-catalyzed [3+2] annulation of isatin-derived enals with cyano- or nitro-substituted chalcones builds spirocyclopentane oxindoles with both enantio- and diastereocontrol, decent yields, broad substrate scope. They also argue the mechanism takes a different path after the first nucleophilic addition than assumed, which is the part worth checking if it holds up.

original_title: Palladium‐Catalyzed Radical Annulation of α‐Iodo‐ gem ‐Diborylalkanes with Alkenes: A Facile Approach to Semisaturated Cyclic Scaffolds
title: Pd radical annulation turns diborylalkanes into semisaturated rings
blurb: A palladium-catalyzed radical annulation of alpha-iodo-gem-diborylalkanes with alkenes, running through a tandem Giese addition/homolytic aromatic substitution, builds the mixed sp2/sp3 cyclic scaffolds med chem likes without the usual long de novo route. Broad heteroaromatic tolerance claimed, but you're still starting from a diborylalkane precursor, not exactly a reagent on everyone's shelf.

original_title: Clinical Value of [ 68 Ga]Ga-FAPI-46 PET/CT Versus [ 18 F]FDG PET/CT for Primary Staging of Gastroesophageal Adenocarcinoma: Results from a Prospective Northern European Trial
title: FAPI-46 PET goes head to head with FDG for staging gastroesophageal cancer
blurb: A prospective Northern European trial pitting Ga-68 FAPI-46 against FDG PET/CT for primary staging of gastroesophageal adenocarcinoma. FAPI reads the stroma instead of glucose uptake, so the interesting question is whether that actually changes staging calls, not just image contrast.

original_title: Preclinical Evaluation of 68Ga-Labeled Heterodimers for Dual Integrin αvβ3 and PARP1-Targeted Tumor Imaging.
title: One Ga-68 tracer, two targets: integrin avb3 and PARP1
blurb: Preclinical Ga-68 heterodimers built to hit both avb3 integrin and PARP1 at once for tumor imaging, betting dual-targeting beats either alone for contrast or specificity. Mouse-level validation so far.

original_title: ESMO: Lilly touts 79% ADC response rate in competitive ovarian cancer space
title: Lilly's ADC posts a 79% response rate in ovarian cancer, phase 1
blurb: Phase 1 data in platinum-sensitive ovarian cancer, a field AbbVie and Genmab are already circling. 79% response rate is the kind of number that turns heads this early, but it's phase 1, no durability or head-to-head data yet.

original_title: ESMO: Takeda’s $1.2B bet on Innovent ‘absolutely’ pays off with details of ADC’s phase 3 win
title: Takeda's $1.2B Innovent bet clears phase 3
blurb: The claudin18.2 ADC Takeda licensed from Innovent posts a phase 3 overall survival of 10.2 months. That's the number meant to justify the $1.2B, assuming it holds up well against whatever it was compared to.

original_title: Photochemically Mediated Oxidative Cross-coupling of Aminopyrazoles with 1-Thiosugars for the Synthesis of Thioglycosides
title: Making thioglycosides by just shining light on thiosugars
blurb: Visible-light photocatalysis pulls a single electron from glycosyl thiols to make thiyl radicals, which add to aminopyrazoles and then oxidatively lose a proton to give thioglycosylated pyrazoles in up to 90% yield. No activated glycosyl donor needed, just light and a photocatalyst.

original_title: A Biphenyl-Containing Dimeric Sulfonamide PET Tracer for High-Contrast Imaging of Carbonic Anhydrase IX in Clear Cell Renal Cell Carcinoma.
title: A dimeric tracer built for imaging kidney cancer's CAIX
blurb: A biphenyl-linked, two-headed sulfonamide PET tracer targeting carbonic anhydrase IX, pitched for higher-contrast imaging of clear cell renal cell carcinoma. That's all I've got on it, no imaging numbers yet.

original_title: BMS’ $4.1B RayzeBio bet delivers Phase 3 radiopharma win - BioSpace
title: BMS's $4.1 billion radiopharma bet just posted a Phase 3 win
blurb: The RayzeBio acquisition clears a Phase 3 readout, the first real sign that the $4.1B BMS paid for it wasn't just FOMO about radiopharma.

original_title: Photoinduced Decarboxylative Radioiodination of (Hetero)aryl Carboxylic Acids.
title: Swapping a carboxylic acid for radioiodine with just light
blurb: A photoinduced decarboxylative route sticks radioiodine directly onto (hetero)aryl carboxylic acids, cutting out the usual halogenation or exchange steps. No yields or scope given yet, so it's a method to watch rather than judge.

original_title: Salubris Biotherapeutics Announces Updated Phase 1b/2 Data for JK06, a 5T4-Targeted Antibody Drug Conjugate, at the European Society for Medical Oncology Congress 2026 - BioSpace
title: Updated readout on Salubris's 5T4 ADC, JK06
blurb: Salubris is bringing updated Phase 1b/2 data on JK06, its 5T4-targeted antibody-drug conjugate, to ESMO 2026. Just the announcement so far, no numbers to weigh in on.

original_title: Zymeworks Presents New Phase 1 Data for Folate Receptor Alpha-Targeting Antibody-Drug Conjugate ZW191 at ESMO Congress 2026 - Carroll County Mirror-Democrat
title: Zymeworks' folate receptor ADC gets another Phase 1 look
blurb: New Phase 1 data on ZW191, Zymeworks' folate receptor alpha ADC, at ESMO 2026. One more FRα ADC trying to find room in a field Elahere already owns.

original_title: Photoactivated Prodrugs Based on Julolidine‐ o ‐Nitrophenethyl Photocages for Traceless Release of Amine Payloads
title: Redshifting the photocage so light can actually reach it in tissue
blurb: A julolidine-based o-nitrophenethyl photocage is electron-rich enough to uncage under visible or two-photon NIR light instead of the usual UV, and it releases its amine payload traceless, no cage fragment left stuck on the drug. The redshift is the whole point, since UV-only triggering never penetrates real tissue.

original_title: A Readily Scalable Silylated Cyclic Allyl Sulfide Monomer for Degradable Vinyl Polymers
title: A degradable comonomer that doesn't fight radical polymerization
blurb: A new silylated cyclic allylic sulfide monomer copolymerizes into ordinary vinyl polymers via radical ring-opening polymerization, building in degradability. The pitch is that it's efficient, versatile, and scalable all at once, which the authors say prior cyclic monomers never managed together. Worth believing once it's run outside a paper.

original_title: Photocatalytic Ring Expansion of Indoles to Benzazepinones through Cyclobutane Fragmentation
title: Turning indoles into seven-membered rings by breaking a cyclobutane
blurb: A dearomative [2+2] photocycloaddition strains indolines into fused cyclobutanes, and acid treatment after N-deprotection fragments them open into benzazepinones, a scaffold medicinal chemists like. With vinyl halide acceptors the fragmentation only runs one stereoelectronic way, and that detail is what actually decides whether it works.

original_title: Santa Ana Bio to Present Preclinical Data on SAB05, a CD40-Targeted Glucocorticoid Antibody-Drug Conjugate, at ACR Convergence 2026 - Yahoo Finance
title: A glucocorticoid ADC aimed at CD40, still preclinical
blurb: Santa Ana Bio is showing preclinical data on SAB05, a CD40-targeted antibody carrying a glucocorticoid payload, at ACR Convergence 2026, an autoimmune play rather than oncology. It's the steroid-sparing pitch, but it's mouse or dish data, nobody's dosed a patient.

original_title: Cellulose-Binding Module-Mediated Immobilization of l-Arabinose Isomerase for Reusable d-Tagatose Production.
title: A cellulose anchor for an enzyme you'd rather not throw away
blurb: L-arabinose isomerase gets fused to a cellulose-binding module so it sticks to a cellulose support instead of washing out after one batch. The whole point is reusability for D-tagatose production, not a new reaction.

original_title: Coordination-strengthened Rhein/Pectin@Zn dual-network hydrogel for local antitumor therapy.
title: A rhein-pectin-zinc gel built to stay put at the tumor
blurb: Zinc coordination bonds tie rhein and pectin into a dual-network hydrogel meant to sit at the tumor site and deliver the drug locally rather than send it through the whole body.

original_title: Ten-Step Total Synthesis of the Octadride (+)-Zopfiellin via Electrochemical Decarboxylative Cross-Coupling
title: Ten steps, no protecting groups, to a fungal eight-membered ring
blurb: First asymmetric synthesis of the antifungal natural products zopfiellin and deoxyzopfiellin, built on a bioinspired electrochemical nickel-catalyzed decarboxylative cross-coupling that joins two simple fragments into the core skeleton. An intramolecular alkylation then closes the tricky eight-membered carbocycle with excellent diastereoselectivity, and the route skips protecting groups entirely and still scales.

original_title: In Situ Generation of Arylacetyl Radicals and Their Unexplored Acylation with Amines
title: Turning hydrazides into a radical nobody had used for amides
blurb: TBHP and catalytic iodine strip arylacetohydrazides down to an arylacetyl radical via oxidative denitrogenation, a species the CV and computational work say was sitting unexplored, and it couples straight onto amines to give arylacetamides in good to excellent yield. Runs at room temperature with a green oxidant, handles late-stage modification of drug molecules, and scales to grams, including a gram-scale run to efaproxiral.

original_title: Antigen persistence after antibody-drug conjugates in urothelial carcinoma: implications for CAR-cell target selection.
title: What's left on urothelial tumor cells after an ADC hits them
blurb: Tracks how much antigen survives on urothelial carcinoma cells after antibody-drug conjugate treatment, which matters because a target already stripped off by the first drug is a poor pick for whatever CAR-cell therapy comes next.

original_title: Cytotoxic and immunogenic signals of small extracellular vesicles from melanoma cells exposed to auger targeted radionuclide therapy.
title: Melanoma cells hit with Auger radiation dump signals on the way out
blurb: Small extracellular vesicles shed by melanoma cells after Auger-electron targeted radionuclide therapy carry both cytotoxic and immune-activating cargo, meaning the damage doesn't necessarily stay contained to the cell that took the dose.

original_title: Alginate-CaCl2 Crosslinked Hydrogels for Gel-Assisted Giant Unilamellar Vesicle Formation.
title: Calcium-crosslinked alginate as scaffolding for growing giant vesicles
blurb: A gel-assisted route to giant unilamellar vesicles that uses alginate crosslinked with CaCl2 as the swelling substrate. Just a methods paper, but GUV formation is finicky enough that a dependable scaffold earns its keep.

original_title: Formal Synthesis of HIF-2α Inhibitor Casdatifan (AB521): Stereospecific Copper(I)-Mediated Ring Opening of Chiral 2-Aryl-cyclopropane-1,1-dicarboxylate with Aryl Grignard Reagents
title: A cheaper back door into casdatifan's hardest stereocenter
blurb: An alternative formal synthesis of the HIF-2alpha inhibitor casdatifan aimed squarely at cost: a chiral cyclopropane-1,1-dicarboxylate built from easy chiral diols gets opened by an aryl Grignard under stereospecific copper(I) catalysis, planting a stereocenter that's normally a pain to reach. A late-stage Friedel-Crafts then closes the tetralin ring to the key diketone intermediate.

original_title: Evaluation and an Exploratory Human Study of 99mTc-Labeled PSMA-Targeting Agents with Reduced Renal Uptake via Proline Incorporation
title: Shrinking the kidney problem in PSMA imaging with a proline kink
blurb: Kidney uptake is the usual complaint with PSMA radioligands, so this swaps in a d- or l-proline as a rigid linker plus tuned co-ligands on 99mTc-labeled tracers. The lead compound, Tc-L-M1, keeps solid affinity for PSMA-positive LNCaP cells (Kd around 19 nM), posts the lowest kidney uptake of the set, and actually made it into an exploratory human study instead of stalling at mice.

original_title: De Novo Design Peptide Probe Enables Super-Resolution Imaging of MFGE8−Integrin Nanoscale Signaling Platforms in Triple-Negative Breast Cancer
title: AI-designed peptides see what antibody labels blur
blurb: Antibody-based super-resolution imaging amplifies its own signal and the bulky complexes get in their own way, so this team used structure-guided, RFdiffusion-based design to build small peptide probes that avoid that, targeting an exposed pocket on MFGE8 around residues 121-126 to map its nanoscale signaling with integrin in triple-negative breast cancer.

original_title: Self-Reporting Fluorescent Prodrug for Esterase-Guided Drug Release and Inflammation-Triggered Bioimaging
title: A prodrug that lights up when it's working
blurb: Naproxen bolted to a dicyanoisophorone dye that stays dark until serum albumin snips the ester bond, which releases the drug and switches the fluorescence on at the same moment. The readout is the release event itself rather than a stand-in for it.

original_title: Developments of Quinoline-Engineered Radioligands for Melanin-Targeted PET Imaging.
title: Quinoline tracers chasing melanin for PET
blurb: A rundown of quinoline-scaffold radioligand designs built to target melanin as a PET imaging handle, relevant mainly for melanoma.

original_title: Double C─Si Bond‐Activating C─C Bond Formation: Palladium‐Catalyzed Synthesis of Silicon‐Tethered Fluorenes via Silacycle‐to‐Palladacycle Si/Pd Exchange
title: Swap silicon for palladium, get a fluorene
blurb: A silacycle-to-palladacycle exchange activates two C-Si bonds at once, turning diarylsilanes into silicon-tethered fluorenes under Pd catalysis, and it still plays nice with several added nucleophiles. A fairly roundabout route, but a clean way to wring complexity out of something as plain as a silane.

original_title: Direct Enantioselective Construction of C3-Nitroalkylated Pyrroles by an Amine-Catalyzed Michael/Paal–Knorr Strategy
title: Pyrroles get a C3 handle, enantioselectively
blurb: An amine-catalyzed Michael addition of succinaldehyde to nitroolefins, followed by an in-situ Paal-Knorr cyclization with primary amines, builds C3-nitroalkylated pyrroles in one pot across N-alkyl, N-aryl, and NH variants in good yield. C3 is normally the hard position to control asymmetrically on an electron-rich ring like this, so landing it in one pot is the actual news.

original_title: Annulative Suzuki–Miyaura Coupling for the Synthesis of Highly Fluorescent Near-Infrared PAH[ b ]-Fused BODIPYs
title: BODIPYs fused into NIR-emitting PAHs in one pot
blurb: Tetrahalogenated BODIPYs run through a fourfold Suzuki cross-coupling/annulation cascade with diboryl arenes or alkenes, no intermediate isolation, giving phenanthro- or naphtho-fused dyes in 32-70% yield that emit in the near-infrared. X-ray shows the frameworks are only slightly twisted, 3-10 degrees, and the NICS calcs back up real aromatic delocalization across the fused rings rather than just a pretty structure.

original_title: Multi-crosslinked sodium alginate fibers with super-hydrophilicity, high strength, flame retardancy, and antibacterial properties.
title: Alginate fibers that do everything at once
blurb: Multi-crosslinked sodium alginate fibers claimed to be super-hydrophilic, high-strength, flame retardant, and antibacterial all together. That's a lot of properties stacked onto one fiber, so I'd want to know what each one costs the others before buying it.

original_title: [18F]ApaScan: A 2-Pyridinylbenzimidazole PET Tracer with Highly Selective Binding to Human Aldosterone-Producing Adenoma Tissue.
title: An 18F tracer that finds the adrenal tumor making too much aldosterone
blurb: [18F]ApaScan, a 2-pyridinylbenzimidazole PET tracer, shows highly selective binding to aldosterone-producing adenoma tissue in humans. A tracer that actually picks out the adenoma itself, rather than just the adrenal gland, would be a real upgrade for localizing these tumors.

original_title: Approaching life in a test tube with prebiotic chemistry
title: Trying to rerun the origin of life in a flask
blurb: A look at what prebiotic chemistry can and can't explain about how amino acids, lipids, sugars, and genetic-polymer building blocks accumulated before life showed up sometime before 3.48 billion years ago. There are no fossils from that window, so the experiments are standing in for a record that simply doesn't exist.

original_title: ESMO: GSK cancer R&D chief says mo-rez data ‘reinforces our belief’ in ADC as phase 3 push ramps up
title: GSK's ADC chief says the early mo-rez data backs the bet
blurb: GSK's cancer R&D head says the latest early-stage readout on its B7-H4-directed ADC mo-rez reinforces the company's belief in the asset, as it moves through a clutch of phase 3 trials already. It's early data and it's the company talking its own book, so the phase 3 readouts are what actually decide this.

original_title: Beyond metal purity with upcycled rare earth mixtures from electronic waste for enantioselective synthesis
title: Dirty rare earth mixtures from e-waste, still good enough to catalyze
blurb: Instead of refining e-waste rare earths down to single-metal purity, this uses the upcycled mixed-metal material as-is for enantioselective catalysis. Skipping the purification step is the whole point, cheaper and greener as long as the mixture doesn't cost you selectivity along the way.

original_title: Kinetic Studies of Oxidative Addition to Well-Defined [Pd0(NHC)(PhC≡CPh)] Complexes (NHC = N-Heterocyclic Carbene)
title: Watching a Pd(0)-NHC complex fall apart while it's still catalyzing
blurb: Electrochemical kinetics on oxidative addition of a chloroarene to a well-defined Pd(0)-NHC alkyne complex. The OA product isolated turns out to be a dimer, and the data point to "cocktail-type" catalysis plus a decomposition route where the NHC itself gets reductively eliminated off the Pd center. Not great news if you were counting on that ligand staying put.

original_title: Silane-Coupled Photo-Oxidized Graphene Grids for Controlling Protein-Surface Interactions in Cryo-EM Sample Preparation.
title: Tuning the chemistry of cryo-EM support grids
blurb: Photo-oxidized graphene grids get a silane coupling step to control how proteins stick to the surface during cryo-EM sample prep. Surface chemistry as the lever, not the microscope.

original_title: Sulfur-Mediated Decarboxylative Thioamidation of α,β-Unsaturated Carboxylic Acids to Lactam-Derived Thioamides
title: Thioamides from lactams without the metal or the oxidant
blurb: Decarboxylative coupling of α,β-unsaturated carboxylic acids with DBN or DBU, with sulfur doing the heavy lifting through polysulfide intermediates and the amidine ring opening along the way, delivers γ-lactam- and ε-caprolactam-derived thioamides. No transition metal, no external oxidant, and the starting materials are the cheap stuff already on hand.

original_title: PhagoID: Quantitative in situ proximity labeling defines the proteomes of bead- and microbe-containing phagosome lumina across species, maturation, and immune activation
title: Finally mapping what's actually inside a phagosome
blurb: A proximity-labeling method (PhagoID) that profiles the protein contents of phagosomes engulfing either beads or live microbes, tracked across species, maturation stages, and immune activation states. A systematic in situ census of a compartment usually studied piecemeal.

original_title: Expanding the HIF-2α proteomic interactome with TurboID proximity labeling.
title: Mapping who HIF-2α actually talks to
blurb: HIF2's gene targets are well mapped, but its protein interaction network much less so. This expands the HIF-2α interactome with TurboID proximity labeling alongside a second proteomic approach, relevant given how central this transcription factor is to hypoxia adaptation and how overexpressed it is in clear cell renal cell carcinoma.

original_title: Pd Embedded in 1T‐Rich MoS 2 With Island‐Sea Confinement for C 2 ‐Selective Ethanol Electrooxidation
title: Getting Pd to stop poisoning itself on ethanol
blurb: Direct ethanol fuel cells keep tripping on Pd catalysts that either botch the C-C cleavage or foul up with CO. Nitrogen doping here converts bulk 2H-MoS2 into a metastable 1T-rich phase riddled with sulfur vacancies, and the conductive 1T patches corral Pd nanoparticles into an island-sea arrangement that pushes the reaction down the C2 pathway to acetate instead, dodging CO formation.

original_title: Injectable Shear Thinning Hydrogels from Functionalized Silk Proteins for 3D Mammalian Cell Culture.
title: Silk hydrogels that shear thin on the way in
blurb: Functionalized silk proteins made into injectable, shear-thinning hydrogels for 3D mammalian cell culture, the kind of gel you can push through a needle and have it set back up once it's in place.

original_title: Calcium Poly(heptazine imide): Reproducible Synthesis for Structural Analysis, Mechanism of CO 2 Uptake, and Evaluation of Photocatalytic CO 2 - to-CO Conversion
title: Making CaPHI reproducibly, finally
blurb: Calcium poly(heptazine imide) has been pitched for CO2 capture and conversion for a while, but the literature synthesis is harsh and gives unpredictable yields nobody could build on. Swapping in a CaCl2-based eutectic medium instead scales the synthesis to hundreds of milligrams and reproduces across labs, with characterization confirming the PHI structure and Ca2+ sitting in the pores driving ionic conductivity. Getting a material everyone can make the same way twice is the actual news here, the photocatalytic CO2-to-CO conversion is the bonus.

original_title: Lysosome-Targeted Iridium(III)-BODIPY Conjugates with GSH-Activatable Reactive Oxygen Species Generation for Enhanced Photodynamic Immunotherapy of Melanoma
title: A photosensitizer that drains glutathione before it lights up
blurb: Two near-infrared iridium(III)-BODIPY conjugates park themselves in the lysosome and burn through glutathione, knocking out the cell's redox defense right before light exposure dumps in reactive oxygen species. The resulting cell death reportedly kicks off dendritic cell maturation and reshapes tumor-associated macrophages, aimed at melanoma, so it's photodynamic therapy trying to drag the immune system along with it.

original_title: Electronic Control of Scholl Cyclization Trajectories Enables Direct Access to Trihetero-Quasi[8]circulenes
title: Steering Scholl reactions by tuning electronics, not luck
blurb: Quasi[8]circulenes are normally a mess to make directly because competing Scholl-type cyclization pathways fight for control. Programming the electronics of the aryl rings on tetrarylthiophene precursors steers the oxidative cyclodehydrogenation to deliver S-, O-, or N-embedded versions on purpose. The payoff is a twisted π-architecture with induced paratropic COT cores and radical cations stable enough to show persistent near-infrared absorption.

original_title: Oxyfunctionalization of Primary Benzylic C(sp3)–H Bonds with Water by a Molybdenum-Dependent Dehydrogenase
title: An enzyme that hydroxylates C–H bonds using plain water
blurb: A molybdenum-dependent dehydrogenase oxyfunctionalizes primary benzylic C(sp3)–H bonds using water as the oxygen source instead of O2 or H2O2, paired with an electron acceptor to pull it off. That sidesteps the usual oxygenase headaches, costly cofactor regeneration and toxic co-substrates, and the paper backs it with structural and computational work, not just activity data.

original_title: Room-Temperature Palladium-Catalyzed Aminative Suzuki–Miyaura Coupling of Arylthianthrenium Salts and Mechanistic Studies
title: Suzuki coupling that hands you a C–N–C bond instead of C–C
blurb: Arylthianthrenium salts run through a palladium-catalyzed coupling at room temperature, but with nitrogen inserted so the product comes out C–N–C instead of the usual Suzuki C–C. Same starting materials, bigger chemical space, and they did the mechanistic digging to back up why it works.

original_title: Cascade Cyclization of 2-Aryl Quinazolinones with 2,2-Difluorovinyl Tosylate: A One-Pot Formal [4 + 2] Approach to Fluorinated Fused Quinazolinones
title: A one-pot route to fluorinated fused quinazolinones
blurb: 2-Aryl quinazolinones plus 2,2-difluorovinyl tosylate cyclize in a tandem C–C/C–N cascade, formally a [4+2], all in one pot in PEG-400. New fluorinated scaffolds out of it, which the authors are pitching at drug discovery, though that's the standard new-heterocycle line.

original_title: Current state and future potential of radiopharmaceutical therapy in breast cancer.
title: Where radiopharmaceutical therapy stands for breast cancer
blurb: A review of radiopharmaceutical therapy's current and future role in breast cancer. Snippet's too thin to say more than that.

original_title: An inversion-forward method for γ-ray spectrum background subtraction based on the ML-EM inversion algorithm
title: Subtracting gamma background by inverting the ML-EM algorithm
blurb: A background-subtraction method for gamma-ray spectra that runs the ML-EM inversion algorithm forward to strip out background rather than the usual fit-and-subtract approach. A niche instrumentation fix, but the kind that matters if you're squeezing real signal out of noisy spectra.

original_title: Enhancing the Activity of CO 2 Hydrogenation to Methanol Catalysts by Controlling the Precipitant to Promote the “Fence‐Fixed” Structure
title: Tuning the precipitant to lock in a better methanol catalyst
blurb: Cu-Zn-Al catalysts for CO2-to-methanol hydrogenation, made with Na2CO3, NaOH, or a mix of both as precipitant. The mixture wins, giving a moderately-ordered layered double hydroxide they call a 'fence-fixed' structure, and that structural control is what bumps up activity rather than any new active-site chemistry.

original_title: Early-Stage Functionalization of AzaDioxaTrianguleniums: Access to 5-Substituted Dyes with Tunable Photophysical and Electrochemical Properties
title: Getting electron-withdrawing groups onto ADOTA+ dyes where EAS can't reach
blurb: Early-stage functionalization of the acridinium precursor installs EWGs at the 5-position of ADOTA+ dyes, a spot electrophilic aromatic substitution can't touch on the finished core. Six derivatives later, you get redshifts without sacrificing the high fluorescence quantum yield or long lifetime, which is the part that actually makes this useful for late-stage diversification.

original_title: Murine Aβ4–x Peptides Retain High-Affinity Redox-Silent Cu2+ Binding
title: Mouse Aβ4-x still binds copper the way the human peptide does
blurb: N-truncated Aβ4-x peptides carry an ATCUN motif that binds Cu2+ tightly and redox-silently in humans, and this paper checks whether the mouse version does the same. It does, which matters for anyone using mouse models to study whether Aβ4-x is a real functional copper-binding peptide rather than an artifact of the human sequence.
